name: Orb of Sorcery

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: A Sorcerer's focus; once a day a Magic action restores up to 2 spent Sorcery Points.
text: A Sorcerer can use this orb as a Spellcasting Focus. Once per dawn, while holding it, you can take a Magic action to regain up to 2 spent Sorcery Points.

powers.name: Draw on the Orb
powers.text: Once a day: regain up to 2 spent Sorcery Points.
